subject: Telemetry vendor sync and transition plan (Amplitude renewal & Mixpanel eval)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Blake <sara.blake@amplitude.com>, contracts@amplitude.com <contracts@amplitude.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry vendor sync — upcoming renewal and transition options

Hi Sara / Amplitude contracts team,

We have your renewal coming up on 2026-09-01 for our main project account (see deal AMPR-2026-Q3-045). Before we get into redlines, I wanted to sync on a couple of operational points so we can decide whether to renew, renegotiate, or transition parts of our telemetry stack to Mixpanel/Segment.

Quick context: over Q2 our API tokenized event volume rose ~38% month-over-month; attached is a usage extract and a matrix comparing costs under our current plan vs a projected optimized plan. We also have an internal requirement to reduce per-event storage cost and cut active vendor count where feasible.

As next steps can you: 1) confirm licensing line items for API ingest vs product analytics seats, 2) share any current offer or renewal discount you can extend to Redwood Inference, and 3) point me to the canonical contract PDF for our account so finance can start review.

I attached a csv with sample telemetry usage and a vendor_contract_matrix for internal reference. Happy to set a 30-min call this week.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Product Analytics
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_telemetry_usage_q2.csv (CSV), vendor_contract_matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Sara Blake <sara.blake@amplitude.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@amplitude.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry vendor sync — upcoming renewal and transition options

Hi Karthik — great to hear from you and congrats on the growth.

Thanks for the usage file. High level: we can structure the renewal to separate API ingest from product analytics seats, and there's typically a renewal discount for multi-year commitments. Based on the sample, there are three levers to reduce your bill: retention tier changes for cold storage, ingest sampling, and a committed throughput block (reserved).

I attached an initial quote PDF that maps to your current consumption and two alternative pricing scenarios (maintain, optimize, and reserved). We can also run a 60–90 day pilot of our new inferencing pipeline (lower-cost storage tier) if you want to measure quality delta.

Quick ask: please confirm which of the three scenarios you want us to model for a formal contract. If helpful, I'll propose a templated SOW and a DocuSign flow for approval.

—Sara
Sara Blake
Enterprise Renewals
Amplitude

Attachments: amplitude_initial_quote.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry vendor sync — upcoming renewal and transition options

+1 to Karthik's summary. I dug into the vendor_contract_matrix and ran a quick TCO for 12 months: keeping Amplitude but moving to a reserved throughput model with tighter retention saves ~22% vs renewing at list. Switching to Mixpanel looks attractive on ingest cost but will require ~6 weeks of engineering effort (event schema migrations and 2 small infra changes). Segment adds integration convenience but doesn't materially lower total cost unless we change retention policy.

Suggested path:
- Short term: negotiate Amplitude reserved throughput + ask for a 10% renewal discount (we get SLA + less migration risk)
- Parallel: run a small proof-of-concept with Mixpanel for our mobile product analytics pipeline (limit scope to two event collections) — measure delta over 60 days

I can draft a short-run MoS (mutual action plan) and scope the POC if you're aligned.

Marissa
Director, Product Analytics
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry vendor sync — upcoming renewal and transition options

Thanks Marissa — that matches my read. Laura/Ben: tagging you for budget + procurement sign-off.

Laura — can finance approve a two-track approach? We accept Amplitude's offer pending negotiation of reserved throughput + a 10% discount, and we start a low-effort Mixpanel POC (60 days, narrow scope) to validate potential long-term savings. If procurement approves, I will: 1) ask Sara to produce a revised contract with reserved terms and a discount, and 2) assign Marissa to run the POC with Tom at Mixpanel.

Proposed timeline: contract negotiation / redline by 2026-07-20; POC kick-off by 2026-07-15; renewal decision by 2026-08-20.

Karthik
